findings.reason: AVAILABLE_CANDIDATE group-level input comprises eight digitized observed means at nominal times, with approximate pixel times and terminal sampling. A311 and A315 state that numeric SD and individual IDs were not recovered; caption n>=3 and methods n=4/time remain separate source statements. Actual collection times are NOT_FOUND. findings.needed_material: Preserve digitization provenance, both sample-count statements, nominal and pixel time distinctions, and missing numeric variability. Have the animal PK module assess sufficiency for the intended group-level use; seek additional source-supported sampling information only where that use depends on it.

findings.reason: This item supports a mouse systemic total-plasma curve for one IV regimen. Requested model outputs and a design-supported held-out prediction opportunity are not established by this page. The ELF note reports IV ELF all BLQ and does not supply a pulmonary concentration-time curve.
findings.needed_material: Map this regimen to the approved mouse systemic objective and retain unresolved model-design and prediction-assessment questions for the animal PK module. Do not infer pulmonary model support from the contextual ELF note.

findings.reason: Mouse serum-binding conflict remains status CONFLICT, resolution_status OPEN, needed_at pk. Mouse free-exposure calculations and binding-dependent translation require sensitivity handling of the conflicting sources. A317 reports same-study plasma fu=0.046, an assay-based mean without recovered numeric uncertainty; it neither supplies both conflicting serum-source definitions nor establishes plasma/serum compatibility. DR009 remains UNRESOLVED. No averaging, conversion or sensitivity computation was performed.
findings.needed_material: Identify the source definitions and experimental contexts and define justified mouse fu sensitivity handling under SC023. Preserve both conflicting sources without averaging and keep the dependent binding decision pending review.

findings.reason: A317 provides a same-study mouse plasma fu input candidate, not a directly measured free-concentration curve. The specific measurement method, concentration range, temperature, pH, recovery, nonspecific binding, mass balance and numeric uncertainty are NOT_FOUND. The source explicitly excludes application to ELF; applicability to the requested free-exposure or translation endpoint remains unresolved.
findings.needed_material: Obtain source-backed binding definitions, assay conditions and endpoint-specific applicability information before using this value for a binding correction. Preserve plasma identity and the ELF restriction; retain independently supported total-plasma work.
